name: Fairfield Town Center
summary: Fairfield Town Center is a well-regarded outdoor shopping center located along U.S. 290 in northwest Houston's growing Cypress-Fairfield area. Featuring convenient central parking and a diverse mix of brand-name stores and eateries, the center serves the surrounding master-planned communities with accessible, quality retail and dining options.
demographics: Fairfield Town Center serves the rapidly growing Cypress-Fairfield area of northwest Houston, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The primary trade area consists of young professionals and families with children, typically aged 25-54, who value convenience and brand-name retailers in an accessible outdoor setting. The center draws heavily from the surrounding master-planned communities and benefits from the area's strong population growth, with shoppers seeking a mix of everyday necessities, dining options, and specialty retail in a modern open-air environment.
description: Fairfield Town Center stands as a premier outdoor shopping destination in the thriving Cypress-Fairfield corridor of northwest Houston, strategically located along U.S. Highway 290. Developed and managed by WPG (Washington Prime Group), this modern community center features a thoughtfully designed open-air layout with convenient central parking that provides easy access to a diverse collection of brand-name retailers and popular dining establishments. The center has become an integral part of the rapidly expanding northwest Houston retail landscape, serving the area's growing population of families and professionals who appreciate the convenience of having quality shopping and dining options close to home. With its attractive outdoor setting and carefully curated tenant mix, Fairfield Town Center offers a comfortable and accessible shopping experience that combines everyday necessities with specialty retail and restaurant choices. The property's strong performance, reflected in its impressive 4.5-star rating from over 3,100 reviews, demonstrates its success in meeting the needs of the dynamic and affluent communities it serves in this high-growth area of Greater Houston.
